entries.title: VW's ID. Era 5S sedan, built in China for China with VW's most advanced automated-driving system, reflects China's rise as a source of cutting-edge auto tech (Bloomberg)
Chinese EDA software provider Phlexing says it has been collaborating with Huawei since 2019 to develop a suite of EDA tools based on Huawei's Tau Scaling Law (Nikkei Asia)
EU officials say the EC is pressing Pornhub, Stripchat, XNXX, and XVideos to introduce tougher age checks as it develops a bloc-wide age verification app (Barbara Moens/Financial Times)
Huawei says HarmonyOS has surpassed 100M installations across smartphones, tablets, and PCs, offering 460K+ apps and services from 12M+ registered developers (Iris Deng/South China Morning Post)
Sources: Samsung and SK Hynix agree to adopt parts of YMTC's "Xtacking" tech for 3D NAND flash via cross-licensing deals, signaling YMTC's rapid tech progress (Nikkei Asia)
OpenAI publishes a preprint claiming to prove that the matrix multiplication exponent (ω) is exactly 9/4, addressing a major open problem in mathematics (Deedy/@deedydas)
Amazon plans to start selling cars online in the UK in early 2027, expanding beyond the US, where it offers new and used cars from 35 brands in 150+ cities (Jamie Nimmo/Bloomberg)
Trump's tech allies reasserted their power in DC by lobbying the president to defy US intelligence agencies and pressure Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO (Financial Times)
NJ-based AidenAI, which helps enterprises integrate AI into apps, data infrastructure, and business workflows, raised a $32M Series A led by A91 Partners (Anne Florentyna/Inc42)
Sources: the EU plans to mobilize up to €50B for its Sovereign Tech Equity Fund to make long-term, high-risk bets on European AI and quantum computing companies (Barbara Moens/Financial Times)
Sources: Muse boosts Meta's ad business by prompting Instagram users to organize saved posts in Muse, reducing shopping friction and increasing advertisers' ROI (Julia Boorstin/CNBC)
Sources: US intelligence officials told congressional aides Alice Huang wasn't directed by China's MSS on Jensen Huang affair, but may have passed intel to MSS (New York Times)
Nutanix CEO Rajiv Ramaswami announces plans to step down and become a senior adviser, but will remain as CEO until a successor is named; he joined in late 2020 (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
HP reports Q4 revenue up 9.3% YoY to $16B, above $15.3B est., gives "prudent" fiscal 2027 guidance above estimates, and says AI PCs reached ~60% of shipments (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
A history professor says GPT-6.2 Astra solved a historical mystery in 22 minutes by identifying the creator of an anonymous 1808 sketchbook held at Yale (Mark Humphries/Generative History)
